item.title: Moment two workers are pulled alive from Nepal tunnel
item.description: Nepal's emergency crews have pulled two workers out of a hydropower tunnel where they had been trapped for nine days. The rescue comes more than a week after flash flooding along the Nepal-Tibet border killed more than 1,200 people. Both men have injuries to their hands and legs and have been airlifted to a hospital in Kathmandu for treatment. Publicado también por: France 24 - English, The Hindu - International, BBC News - World. Fuente: Al Jazeera English.

item.title: El Nino could be strongest in decades, UN warns
item.description: El Nino could be the strongest since records began four decades ago, the United Nations' climate agency warned Thursday, with the UN chief warning the world is in the "danger zone of extreme weather". The naturally-occurring weather phenomenon is set to become "very strong" in the months ahead and is near certain to persist through to February, the World Meteorological Organization (WMO) said. FRANCE 24's Journalist Carys Garland tells us more. Publicado también por: Phys.org, France 24 - English, ABC News Australia. Fuente: The Hindu - International.
